notes: The opening yet is added: rule 86's test is whether a source token of this verse carries the subordination, and the concessive it answers is echon in PHM.1.8, already spent there on though I have.
dia ten agapen keeps the whole discontinuous for ... sake wrap on the expressed preposition headed on for, under rule 78 rather than rule 67's divided contiguous-frame case.
toioutos is anarthrous here, so no article is in question and rule 17's generic-completion clause keeps the head on such rather than on the supplied one.
